arguments.note: The amm 316L material has E_s = 193 GPa. For a porous periodic cell made of this isotropic solid and void, the uniform-strain variational bound gives C_eff <= phi C_s and hence directional Young's modulus E_eff <= phi E_s. With phi <= 0.16, E_eff <= 30.88 GPa in any direction, below the required 38.6 GPa (= 0.20 E_s). Thus the requirements are incompatible regardless of topology or cell size; no design is released.
